column1: # Functional labels for the de novo type II TA arm.
#   rescue    - antitoxin restored growth against this toxin (functional positive)
#   no_rescue - antitoxin was tested and did NOT restore growth (functional negative)
#   UNKNOWN   - not established from a source I could read. Rows marked UNKNOWN are
#               SKIPPED by build_denovo_set.py; they are never assumed either way
#               because a wrong label here silently corrupts the calibration.
# Every non-UNKNOWN row must cite where the label came from in `source`.
